positions.name: ImmediateReturnRememberContract
positions.frame: what is the contract for the immediate-return remember dispatch — its return semantics, polling model, and failure guarantees?
positions.why: All three expressions cohere under one directional read of the async job contract for 'remember': src-1 declares the ratified contract (receipt in seconds, extraction watched by polling a cursor), src-2 asserts its non-blocking and lost-work-prevention properties, and src-3 restates the key decision at conversation level (dispatch then poll or piggyback). Wynn's two quotes carry the contract's terms; Xena's editorial narration carries the settled conclusion. The frame asks what the contract is — the members, read through it, supply the answer.
